question: Which basic neural architecture perform best by itself?
title: Neural Architectures for Fine-Grained Propaganda Detection in News
answer_rationale: The retrieved documents discuss various neural architectures (CNN, LSTM-CRF, BERT) and their combinations (ensembles, multi-tasking) for propaganda detection tasks, but none explicitly state which single architecture performs best by itself. Performance comparisons are made between ensembles or combinations, not individual architectures in isolation.
